verdict.rationale: The skills manage YYLO Ledger records, so data portability is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack documents no bulk export command or open-format data dump. Retrieving a single record by ID, filtered listing, and soft-delete archiving are adjacent operations, not an export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
